_comment: Agent registry for the Dusk dashboard. Each agent: id, name, stateFile (hud_state-style JSON: {state, agent, detail, thoughts, ts}), systemdUnit (user unit controlled via systemctl --user start/stop/restart). stateFile may be absolute, ~-relative, or relative to this directory. Agents without a systemdUnit are status-only. Add an entry here and the dashboard picks it up on next launch - no code changes.
